design: Arm 1 stage 1, five scenarios per call, seeds 1-10 (superseded)
scenarios: the sentences are no longer in scenarios_bio_enc.json, which now holds the one-per-call design; they are preserved verbatim as scenario_text in thesis-work/experiments/arms/rows_bio_enc.jsonl, keyed by scenario_seed/scenario_idx (s<seed>.<idx>)
classified_by: hand, reading each sentence against the behaviours the never-killed mutants require (thesis-work/experiments/triage/bio_enc.json)
note: Rows are the behaviours a test must exhibit to kill a surviving mutant, not generic test categories. A scenario counts only if it names the behaviour, not if it merely operates in the same function. The stimulus/oracle split is recorded because it is the finding: a scenario can propose the right input and still not propose anything that would observe the difference.

zero-length read (L76).needs: BIO_read(b, buf, 0) and check the return

leak on free (L89, L93, L96).needs: a leak detector; not available in this harness

call-pattern oracle (L134, L180, L199).needs: a source BIO that records the size of each read

retry / non-blocking (L208, L233, L263,.needs: a peer that sets retry flags, then BIO_should_retry

sink returns exactly 0 (L254, L283).needs: a custom sink BIO whose write returns 0

short read, outl <= 256 (L199).needs: read in <=256-byte chunks from a full source
